Because Pydantic v2 automatically evaluates and includes computed_field properties during serialization in response_model, any authenticated coworker can view the exact annual salary and tax SSN suffixes of any other employee.

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Optional

router = APIRouter(prefix="/hr/employees")

class EmployeePublicProfile(BaseModel):
    id: str
    full_name: str
    department: str
    job_title: str

@router.get("/{employee_id}/public-profile", response_model=EmployeePublicProfile)
async def get_employee_public_profile(
    employee_id: str,
    hr_service: HRDirectoryService = Depends(get_hr_service),
    colleague: EmployeeUser = Depends(get_current_employee)
):
    emp = await hr_service.find_employee(employee_id)
    if not emp:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Employee not found")
    if emp.organization_id != colleague.organization_id and not colleague.is_hr_manager:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: unauthorized to view employee directory outside your organization")

    return EmployeePublicProfile(
        id=emp.id,
        full_name=emp.full_name,
        department=emp.department,
        job_title=emp.job_title
    )
